title: OutputTombstone
description: Written when an output is deleted (watermarking v2 §6): the audio goes, the fact it existed is kept, so deleted material found in the wild is still identifiable. Lives at outputs/<artist>/.tombstones/<generation_id>.json and syncs like every canonical file.

run_id.description: The adapter run that generated it.

fingerprint_version.description: Format of the fingerprints array; v1 is defined at phase 5.

fingerprints.description: Landmark (hash, offset_ms) pairs of the deleted audio, for wild identification (fingerprint format v1).
